slot_scores.name: idle_time_no_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Should the cost of machine and craftsman time be treated as a fixed weekly expense that does not depend on usage, or should it be deducted from revenue based on the actual hours consumed by the production plan
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether costs depend on actual usage, which is related to idle-time cost, but did not explicitly ask whether unused/idle time incurs a cost.

slot_scores.name: fractional_batches_allowed
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are the production quantities for products X and Y required to be whole numbers (integer batches), or can they be fractional?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether production quantities can be fractional or must be integer.

slot_scores.name: all_batches_sold
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether all produced batches are sold or whether there is any demand constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Idle or unused machine and craftsman time incurs no cost; only actual usage is charged.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent asked about usage-based versus fixed costs but did not explicitly confirm that idle time is free, then modeled costs as usage-based only.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: All produced batches are sold, with no demand cap or inventory considerations.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether all produced batches are sold or whether demand constraints exist, but modeled revenue as simply 20x + 30y.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All hidden slots are P2, so stopping after resolving the fractional-batch question and partially addressing idle-time cost is appropriate; no P0 or P1 slots remain unresolved.

summary: The agent directly clarified fractional batches and asked a related but incomplete question about idle-time costs, but never asked whether all produced batches are sold. Since all hidden slots are P2, the stop was appropriate despite the remaining minor unconfirmed assumptions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
